subject: 30 days inside the 4x club
preview_text: Your first month with SoulPlan—see how you compare to the 4x couples and what's next for you both.
body_paragraphs: There's a quiet revolution happening inside SoulPlan. Couples who use Tonight's Date in their first 24 hours plan 4x more dates over the next month. You're now 30 days in—and you're part of the group doing romance differently. No more scrolling through tired lists. No more 'what do you want to do?' ping-pong.

That 4x number isn't a gimmick. It's the result of one tap on a mood—cozy, adventurous, playful, healing—and a date that lands in seconds, not minutes. The data is clear: couples who start here stay here. Their Memory Timelines grow. Their streaks get longer. Their partner gets a full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment, not a bare notification. You're building a shared history, night by night.

And you're not alone. There's a whole community of couples inside SoulPlan, sharing moments, liking each other's dates, and reminding each other that romance isn't a chore—it's a choice. The Wishlist, the Anniversaries jar, the no-shame freeze—everything is designed to keep you in motion, together. You've already crossed the 30-day threshold. The next 30 are where the real magic happens.

Open SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together now and check your streak. See how many dates you've logged, how your Memory Timeline is shaping up, and peek at the community feed. One date tonight changes everything. P.S. — The couples who hit a 7-day streak in their first month have a 90% retention rate at 90 days. You're already closer than you think.
